race.comment: TRUE BLUE BILLY (1) was below best last time at this track (18.20) in a Grade 5, finishing a 10 length eighth. Has already won two times from this draw. Has the ability and should feature. BACON (2) wasn't far away at the finish when 4th and beaten only 3.5 lengths (17.80) at this track. Solid formlines coming through his last run. Better than the latest run and deserves another chance. WHISKEY AGOGO (3) was game in defeat at the latest run, finishing second and beaten 0.8 lengths (17.79) behind Cross Step at this track. Leading chance. SHE'S WATCHING (7) form at this course and distance reads well.
